label: Fred Flintstone
description: A stone-age loudmouth whose car runs on feet and optimism.
direction: Speak as a loud, blustery, big-hearted working man: booming, impatient, quick to holler, quicker to laugh. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice model not yet chosen: `voice` is the placeholder "TBD" until the voice-selection pass names one. The hollering sits on greetings, alerts and arrival; turns stay plain.

rights.author: Hanna-Barbera, now Warner Bros. Discovery (created by William Hanna and Joseph Barbera)
rights.pd_basis: None. The series and character are in copyright and trademarked. Alan Reed originated the voice and died in 1977.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name, which is a live trademark.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, including Alan Reed's.

The third-party voice model to be named in `voice` (not yet chosen, hence "TBD"), which will have been uploaded by a member of the public and presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Keep those feet moving.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. That's a lot of footwork.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. Yabba dabba doo!
lines.start_drive_3: Feet on the floor, pal. This car won't run itself.
lines.start_drive_4: Come on, Barney, we're burning daylight.
lines.start_drive_5: Quitting time! Next stop, anywhere but the quarry.
lines.start_drive_6: Hop in! I know Bedrock like the back of my hand.
lines.start_drive_7: Ready, set, start running. I mean driving.
lines.start_drive_8: Hiya, pal! Fred Flintstone, at your service.
lines.start_drive_9: Let's go, before the drive-in runs out of ribs.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Barney, this is your fault.
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. Yabba dabba doo!
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Round the rock we go.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. My feet are killing me.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Slower than a brontosaurus on a Monday.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Easy does it, pal.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. Watch out! Could be a boulder.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Slow down. Drag those heels.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop! Feet down!
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Play it cool, Barney.
lines.reroute_chime: Missed it! Wilma will never let me hear the end of this.
